SELECT /*LGVATT00023.retrieveVendorInfomation*/ vm.vendor_id AS vendor_id ,vm.vendor_code AS vendor_code ,vm.vendor_name AS vendor_name ,vm.remark AS remark ,TO_CHAR(vm.effective_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date ,TO_CHAR(vm.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date ,(select local_language_full_name from lgcom_user_m where application_user_id = vm.creation_user_id) as creation_user_id /* 등록자ID */ ,TO_CHAR(vm.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as creation_date /* 등록일자 */ FROM TB_VENDOR_MASTER vm WHERE 1 = 1
AND (UPPER(vm.vendor_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{vendorName}) || '%')
ORDER BY vm.vendor_id, vm.vendor_code asc
